{{Quote|The discovery of life, any life, is remarkable and opens up a new world of answers to some of our most ancient questions. We are determined to protect lifeform PDC3141-02, for it has as much right to exist as your or I.|[[Unigard Lom]], xenobiologist from the University of Sanbra|<ref name="HNN48">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|48|regional/13321_2.html|Dumping Prohibited on PDC3141-02}}</ref>}}
'''Lifeform PDC3141-02''' was a unicellular species of life found on the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] known only as [[PDC3141-02]]. It was discovered shortly before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] by [[Xenobiologist/Legends|xenobiologists]] from the [[University of Sanbra]]. When it was discovered, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] prohibited dumping [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]] material on the planetoid. The [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], the owner of the planetoid, protested this law.
